summary.en: Thai authorities seized 8kg of hydroponic cannabis at the Nepal border and foiled a 700kg methamphetamine shipment bound for Malaysia, prompting heightened alert over cross-border drug networks. Bomb explosions in southern Thailand injured police, leading to tighter border security and expanded intelligence work, while a drone was detected attacking a Russian cargo ship in the Baltic, illustrating broader security concerns. Cambodia is escalating the Thailand border dispute at ASEAN and other international forums, receiving U.S. backing, and has detained Cambodians crossing a suspected minefield. China and Thailand are advancing rail links to Malaysia and Singapore, and Thailand is negotiating aviation hub status and cross-border water-pollution mitigation with China. The UCDP recorded 35 battle-related deaths in 2024, according to UCDP.

background.title: Southern Thailand insurgency
background.extract: The Southern Thailand insurgency is an ongoing conflict centered in southern Thailand. It originated in 1948 as a separatist insurgency in the historical Malay Patani Region, made up of the three southernmost provinces of Thailand and parts of a fourth, but has become more complex and increasingly violent since the early 2000s from drug cartels, oil smuggling networks, and sometimes pirate raids.
background.extractNb: Opprøret i Sør-Thailand er en pågående konflikt mellom thailandske styrker og islamistiske separatistgrupper, i de tre sørligste provinsene i Thailand. Volden sprer seg også i økt grad over til andre provinser. Selv om separatistene riktignok har opptrådt voldelig i flere tiår, eskalerte kampanjen deres i 2004.
